document.adaptation: Two lead-ins with their block quotes rewritten as inline quotes; the quoted name “McDonald Curry” put in single quotes inside the quote.
document.text: “I think, McDonald insist on pursuing this matter because they also one day would roll out their new product called McCurry. Since they also lost the battle, they have to give their dish another name, may be ‘McDonald Curry’,” writes My Journal. After learning about the court ruling, Malaysian Life exclaims: “Wow, I don't believe it but it's true. I guess it is possible to beat an international company in a lawsuit.”
